title: Plan Z: AI Tutorial Video
summary: Course outline → script → screen capture / images → AI narration → captions
scenario: For software tutorials or online course videos, using AI to produce teaching content at low cost and in volume.

steps.title: Course outline
steps.detail: Define the target students and learning outcomes, then have the model build a modular outline where each module delivers something concrete, ordered by dependency, with 5-10 minute episodes.
steps.tips: Put 'what you'll be able to do' into the outline titles — perceived value jumps instantly.

steps.title: Script
steps.detail: Write the lesson in conversational language: one idea per sentence, steps framed as 'first… then…', with a note on what to show on screen and where to pause for each step.
steps.tips: Add pause markers in the script so the narration lines up with the screen recording later.

steps.title: Screen capture / images
steps.detail: Record the actual screen while you operate the software, and generate consistent-styled diagrams for concepts; match each step to a script section and re-record anything that's off right away.
steps.tips: Write the operation checklist before recording and finish in one take to avoid fumbling.

steps.title: AI narration
steps.detail: Turn the script into clear, natural AI narration at a slightly slower teaching pace; preview how technical terms are pronounced before committing to the full read.
steps.tips: Listen to a 30-second sample first — discovering a mispronounced term at the end means regenerating everything.

steps.title: Captions & export
steps.detail: Auto-generate subtitles, proofread them, and export multiple formats — mp4 for course platforms plus vertical cuts for short video — with chapter markers and exercises.
steps.tips: End each episode with a next-episode teaser and a practice task to raise series completion.

pitfalls.title: Episodes too long
pitfalls.detail: Completion craters past 15 minutes; split into 5-10 minute episodes.

pitfalls.title: Script reads like a textbook
pitfalls.detail: Conversational writing with transitions beats reading aloud.

pitfalls.title: Cuts too fast
pitfalls.detail: Fast screen edits lose students; slow down key steps or highlight them.

pitfalls.title: No version labeling
pitfalls.detail: Software UI changes fast — put the version and date in the title to cut support questions.
